value.rationale: This settles a motivated inverse distinguishability problem for an infinite natural family: counting all qf types numerically reconstructs the atom-cycle parameters except a unique smallest collision. It separately determines exactly when automorphism invariance entails qf definability, revealing a sharp m=2 versus m=3 threshold. These are nontrivial, logically motivated classifications rather than an arbitrary numerical slice or a table lookup.
